run_video_classification_training: run video classification training with frozen encoder and trainable attentive classifiers on distributed GPUs
create_dataloader_video_dataset: create dataloaders for video classification with configurable clip length, frame step, and augmentation transforms
init_optimizers_with_schedules: initialize AdamW optimizers with cosine learning rate and weight decay schedules for each classifier head
load_training_checkpoint: load training checkpoint with classifiers, optimizers, and gradient scaler state for resuming interrupted training
test_val_only_classification: run validation-only evaluation of frozen encoder video classification with trained attentive classifier heads
